name: skeleton
title: Skeleton
description: Loading placeholder: the kind of content before it arrives, so the layout does not jump when it does. Decorative by design (aria-hidden) — announce the loading state once, on the region, with a <Spinner> or aria-busy, not on every shimmer. The pulse animation is disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.
docs: Part of the AI Design System. Its full contract — every prop, its allowed values and what each one means — is at https://github.com/axdes/AI-Design-system/blob/main/registry/Skeleton.json
